factual_claims.claim: For the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year ending June 30, 2025, SAF Tehnika reported an unaudited consolidated net turnover of EUR 26.11 million, representing a 4% decline compared to EUR 27.09 million in the previous financial year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: For the 12 months of the 2024/2025 financial year, the Group’s unaudited consolidated turnover was EUR 26.11 million, a 4% decline from the previous financial year’s revenue.

factual_claims.claim: The Group closed the twelve-month period with a net loss of EUR 820 thousand, which shows an improvement compared to the net loss of EUR 2.37 million reported for the 2023/2024 financial year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The consolidated unaudited result for the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year is a loss of EUR 820 thousand. The Group reported a loss of EUR 2.37 million for the 2023/2024 financial year.

factual_claims.claim: For the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year, the Group generated an unaudited net turnover of EUR 5.18 million, down 13% compared to EUR 5.98 million in the corresponding period of the prior year, and recorded a quarterly net loss of EUR 913 thousand compared to a loss of EUR 498 thousand in the fourth quarter of the 2023/2024 financial year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s unaudited consolidated net turnover for the fourth quarter (Q4) of the 2024/2025 financial year (FY) was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease compared to the same period in FY 2023/2024. The Group closed the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year with a loss of EUR 913 thousand (unaudited). In Q4 of the previous year, the Group recorded a loss of EUR 498 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Geographically, revenues from North and Latin America accounted for 55% of the total 12-month turnover, amounting to EUR 14.28 million and decreasing by 14% compared to the previous financial year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Over a 12-month period, revenues in North and Latin Americas represented 55% of the total turnover of the Group and amounted to EUR 14.28 million, thus showing a 14% decrease compared to the result of the twelve months of previous financial year.

factual_claims.claim: European revenues grew by 17% to EUR 10.04 million, representing 38% of the total turnover, while revenues from Asia, Africa, and the Middle East declined by 5% to EUR 1.78 million, accounting for 7% of total turnover.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 38% of the total turnover comes from revenues generated in European countries, which increased by 17% against 12 months of the previous year, and amount to EUR 10.04 million. Revenue from the Asia, Africa and the Middle East region declined by 5%, accounting for 7% of the Group’s total turnover.

factual_claims.claim: During the fourth quarter specifically, regional performance showed a 40% decrease in the Americas to EUR 2.5 million, a 24% increase in Europe to EUR 1.9 million, and a doubling of turnover in Asia, Africa, and the Middle East to EUR 846 thousand compared to the fourth quarter of the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The turnover of the North America and Latin America region amounted to 47% or EUR 2.5 million. Compared to the same quarter of the previous financial year, the turnover has decreased by 40%. The European region accounted for 36% of turnover, amounting to EUR 1.9 million, an increase of 24% compared with the fourth quarter of the previous financial year. Turnover in the Asia, Africa and Middle East region doubled compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, representing 16% of the total quarterly turnover (or EUR 846 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: The Group noted that quarterly turnover fluctuations are influenced by the completion, scope, complexity, production duration, and material procurement lead times of individual projects, which frequently result in revenue recognition occurring in subsequent quarters.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Fluctuations in quarterly turnover are influenced by the completion of individual projects. Projects can vary in scope and complexity, and their execution is influenced by both the duration of the production process and the lead times for material procurement. As a result, the dispatch of goods and the recognition of revenue often take place only in subsequent quarters.
